objects: tables:all LLD-05 tables declared by the seven schema_sources

cross_packet_reference_policy: LLD-05 may physically reference already-migrated LLD-01 command receipts, LLD-03 Service Request/RFC/Device Reference identities and LLD-02 canonical IDs where the schema declares a physical FK.

LLD-07 Inventory dependencies are runtime participant/provider relationships; sequence 5 creates no FK into future sequence-7 Inventory tables, preventing a migration-order cycle and preventing Inventory from owning Task lifecycle.
